title: The kbmon mod tells a disk entry again each time its free percentage moves, so a disk filling under the low-free threshold notifies on nearly every refresh
goal: the kbmon mod tells a disk entry of the needs-you line once while the disk stays under the low-free threshold, whatever its free percentage reads

gates.question: How does the mod ignore a moved figure in a needs-you entry: strip it from the compared entry, or leave the key and say in the docs that a moved figure is news?
options: strip the figures from the compared entry
keep the entry text as the key and document that a moved figure is news
gates.recommendation: strip the figures from the compared entry
gates.answer: strip the figures from the compared entry

notes: Found by the review of SP-rin4kkoj (2026-10-24, S2). mon_host rounds free_pct to one decimal and mon_needs writes `disk 9.4% free`; register.tsx entriesOf keeps that text, so 9.4 then 9.3 reads as one entry gone and one new. The same goes for any cause text that carries a number (fast-forward or delivery `why`). Decision for the operator: strip the percentage from the entry key (this repro), or say in kb/_self/monitoring.md that a moved figure is news. Plan 2026-10-24 (day run, pre-approved by the operator): the open choice takes the easy-to-reverse option: strip the numbers from the compared entry (the percentage and any figure in a cause text) in register.tsx entriesOf, so a moved figure is not news; say so in kb/_self/monitoring.md (The notification). No gate. Planned into SP-ymnz7b4n, 2026-10-24 day run. Precheck: repro fails on the base. Gate g1 answered by the day-run runner with its recommendation, the operator's stated choice for this item (pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-24 day run): strip the figures from the compared entry.
